name: @openvole/paw-recall
description: Memory with a memory model — typed records, hybrid retrieval with decay, pluggable storage backends

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Hybrid search over memory records (semantic + keyword + recency + importance)

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Store a memory record (episodic, semantic, procedural, or entity)

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Read a record by id, or the curated digest

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: List recent memory records with filters

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Archive a memory record (excluded from recall, never deleted)

tools.name: memory_pin
tools.description: Pin or unpin a record — pinned records never decay and always appear in the digest
